newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Dunlop shut after worker unrest.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Dunlop shut after worker unrest.

text.p: Nigerian tyre maker Dunlop said on Wednesday it had closed its factory following a disruption of activities there by some of its workers.
The company said in a statement it took the action on Tuesday after some of its 1,000 staff molested and intimidated management over a recent pay increase for the workers.

"Management is quite surprised that the salary increase, which was a management initiative to improve the workers' standard of living, is being used by dissatisfied workers, who are being instigated by external forces to disrupt the company's operations," it said.
Local newspapers said anti-riot police were called into the company's factory on the outskirt of Lagos to maintain peace.
They quoted a spokesman for the staff union as saying they were offered increases of between 20 to 40 percent instead of the 100 percent they had demanded.
Dunlop shares which are enjoying renewed investor interest closed at 10.40 naira on Tuesday on the Nigerian stock market.
